A centred heading, from a CMS that had a colour picker

Right-aligned body text. The declaration goes back out spelled the way it came in, rather than in whatever form the CSSOM prefers.

A line height OpenLeaf does not model, sitting beside an alignment it does. Modelling one must not cost the other.

Red text and a highlighted run, both of which have to stay editable text rather than becoming opaque preserved cards.

A span carrying more than colour is preserved whole, because the marks cannot hold the rest of it.

A font tag carrying more than colour, for the same reason.
